headline: Polymarket Probes Suspicious Account Bets Placed on Israeli Election
summary: Prediction platform Polymarket opened an investigation into hundreds of newly created accounts that placed wagers on Benjamin Netanyahu and the Likud party shortly before polls closed in Israel's election.
why: Polymarket and decentralized prediction platforms are drawing heavy regulatory scrutiny over integrity, manipulation risks, and insider betting around political outcomes.

impacts.name: Prediction Markets
impacts.why: Investigations into suspicious trading patterns increase regulatory scrutiny over market integrity.
